name: deepseek-work
description: A supervised Electron desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness.
author: AstraClaw Team

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.dev: pnpm run generate:assets && pnpm run build && electron .
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run prepare:runtime && pnpm run generate:assets && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.pack:win: pnpm run prepare:runtime && pnpm run generate:assets && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
scripts.release:win: pnpm run dist:win && pnpm run verify:signatures && pnpm run smoke:packaged
scripts.smoke: pnpm run generate:assets && pnpm run build && electron . --smoke
